title: The $1B solo founder prediction is BS.
description:
The CEOs predicting a solo unicorn this year sell compute. Of course they predict the gold rush — they need every solopreneur to believe they need 10,000 GPUs. The actual data: solo founders cluster between $200k and $500k a year. AI raised the floor. It didn't open a billion-dollar door. $300k a year, solo, is rich enough. Aim there.

#solopreneur #AI #startup #realistic #buildloop #shorts
